data.one_liner: Plugin to read current app flavor from native code
data.what_it_does: Flavor Getter allows Flutter code to query the flavor (variant) the app is running in. It exposes a simple async method that returns a string representing the flavor set in the native build configuration.
use_when: When you need to branch logic based on the current flavor
During debugging or logging to verify the active flavor
When building a single codebase for multiple environments (dev, prod, staging)
avoid_when: When your project does not use flavors
When you prefer to hardcode environment values instead of querying at runtime
weaknesses: Only works on Android and iOS
No support for web or desktop
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a FLAVOR build setting and Info.plist entry on iOS, and defining productFlavors and buildFeatures in Android Gradle. No permissions or build_runner needed.
